All state-mutating operations (borrow, repay, accrue_interest, liquidate, flash loan) maintain internally consistent accounting; `withdraw_underlying` (L313) asserts `cash >= cash_reserve.ceil()` after every withdrawal, ensuring N ≥ 0 always. The `repay_fee_rate`-as-`reserve_factor` issue (market.move:L1025) affects protocol revenue split but does not violate the identity.
